parameters.name: AclEntrys
parameters.description:
The access control policy group settings. Valid values:

* **entry**: The IP entry to add to the access control policy group. You can specify CIDR blocks. Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas (,).

* **comment**: The description of the access control policy group.

>You can add up to 50 entries at a time. If duplicate IP entries are added, only one entry is retained and the duplicate entries are ignored. IP entries must be CIDR blocks.

parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the access control policy group.
